description_ja: Cln3はCdc28と複合体を形成しキナーゼを活性化（Cln1/2/3各複合体とFar1・Fus3の結合も解析）
description_en: Cln3 forms a complex with Cdc28 and activates the kinase (the study also analysed Cln1/2/3 complexes and binding of Far1 and Fus3).
references: Tyers M, Futcher B. Mol Cell Biol 13:5659-69 (1993) <pmid:8395009>

description_ja: Cln3-Cdc28がWhi5をリン酸化し、SBF/MBFからの解離と核外移行を誘導
description_en: Cln3-Cdc28 phosphorylates Whi5, driving its dissociation from SBF/MBF and its nuclear export.
references: Costanzo M et al. Cell 117:899-913 (2004) <pmid:15210111> | de Bruin RA et al. Cell 117:887-98 (2004) <pmid:15210110>

description_ja: Whi5はプロモーター上のSBFに結合しG1/S転写を抑制
description_en: Whi5 binds SBF at promoters and represses G1/S transcription.
references: Costanzo M et al. Cell 117:899-913 (2004) <pmid:15210111> | de Bruin RA et al. Cell 117:887-98 (2004) <pmid:15210110>

description_ja: Pcl9-Pho85もWhi5をリン酸化し、HDAC(Hos3/Rpd3)との会合を阻害
description_en: Pcl9-Pho85 also phosphorylates Whi5 and blocks its association with HDACs (Hos3/Rpd3).
references: Huang D et al. PLoS Biol 7:e1000188 (2009) <pmid:19823668>

description_ja: Swi4–Swi6複合体(SBF)の形成。Swi4 C末端がSwi6会合に必要
description_en: Formation of the Swi4-Swi6 complex (SBF). The Swi4 C-terminus is required for Swi6 association.
references: Sidorova J, Breeden L. Mol Cell Biol 13:1069-77 (1993) <pmid:8423776>

description_ja: Mbp1–Swi6複合体(MBF)の同定。mbp1 swi4二重欠損は致死
description_en: Identification of the Mbp1-Swi6 complex (MBF). The mbp1 swi4 double mutant is lethal.
references: Koch C et al. Science 261:1551-7 (1993) <pmid:8372350>

description_ja: SBF(Swi4)がCLN1/CLN2(およびPCL1/HCS26)の転写を直接活性化
description_en: SBF (Swi4) directly activates transcription of CLN1/CLN2 (and PCL1/HCS26).
references: Ogas J, Andrews BJ, Herskowitz I. Cell 66:1015-26 (1991) <pmid:1832336>

description_ja: CLB5/CLB6はG1後期にCln依存的に転写される（MBF標的）
description_en: CLB5/CLB6 are transcribed in late G1 in a Cln-dependent manner (MBF targets).
references: Koch C et al. Science 261:1551-7 (1993) <pmid:8372350> | Schwob E, Nasmyth K. Genes Dev 7:1160-75 (1993) <pmid:8319908>

description_ja: Far1がCdc28-Clnキナーゼ活性を直接阻害
description_en: Far1 directly inhibits Cdc28-Cln kinase activity.
references: Peter M, Herskowitz I. Science 265:1228-31 (1994) <pmid:8066461> | Tyers M, Futcher B. Mol Cell Biol 13:5659-69 (1993) <pmid:8395009>

description_ja: Cln-Cdc28によるFar1リン酸化がSCF-Cdc4依存分解を誘導
description_en: Phosphorylation of Far1 by Cln-Cdc28 triggers its SCF-Cdc4-dependent degradation.
references: Henchoz S et al. Genes Dev 11:3046-60 (1997) <pmid:9367986>

description_ja: Sic1はClb-Cdc28を阻害しG1/S移行を制御
description_en: Sic1 inhibits Clb-Cdc28 and controls the G1/S transition.
references: Schwob E et al. Cell 79:233-44 (1994) <pmid:7954792> | Mendenhall MD. Science 259:216-9 (1993) <pmid:8421781>

description_ja: G1-CDKによるSic1リン酸化（3部位）が分解とS期進入に必須
description_en: Phosphorylation of Sic1 by G1 CDK (three sites) is required for its degradation and S-phase entry.
references: Verma R et al. Science 278:455-60 (1997) <pmid:9334303>

description_ja: SCF(Cdc4)+Cdc34がリン酸化Sic1をユビキチン化（再構成系）
description_en: SCF(Cdc4) with Cdc34 ubiquitinates phosphorylated Sic1 (reconstituted system).
references: Feldman RM et al. Cell 91:221-30 (1997) <pmid:9346239>

description_ja: SCF(Grr1)+Rbx1(Hrt1)がリン酸化Cln1をユビキチン化
description_en: SCF(Grr1) with Rbx1 (Hrt1) ubiquitinates phosphorylated Cln1.
references: Skowyra D et al. Science 284:662-5 (1999) <pmid:10213692>

description_ja: Pho80-Pho85がPho4をリン酸化し核外移行・不活性化
description_en: Pho80-Pho85 phosphorylates Pho4, causing its nuclear export and inactivation.
references: Kaffman A et al. Science 263:1153-6 (1994) <pmid:8108735> | O'Neill EM et al. Science 271:209-12 (1996) <pmid:8539622>

description_ja: CDK阻害因子Pho81が低リン酸条件でPho80-Pho85を不活性化
description_en: The CDK inhibitor Pho81 inactivates Pho80-Pho85 under low phosphate.
references: Schneider KR, Smith RL, O'Shea EK. Science 266:122-6 (1994) <pmid:7939631>

description_ja: サイクリンHcs26(Pcl1)–Pho85複合体による細胞周期制御
description_en: Cell-cycle control by the cyclin Hcs26 (Pcl1)-Pho85 complex.
references: Espinoza FH et al. Science 266:1388-91 (1994) <pmid:7973730>

description_ja: Cak1がCdc28 T169をリン酸化（出芽酵母の生理的CAK）
description_en: Cak1 phosphorylates Cdc28 on T169 (the physiological CAK of budding yeast).
references: Kaldis P, Sutton A, Solomon MJ. Cell 86:553-64 (1996) <pmid:8752210>

description_ja: DNA損傷時Rad53依存的にSwi6がリン酸化されCLN1/2転写が抑制
description_en: On DNA damage, Swi6 is phosphorylated in a Rad53-dependent manner and CLN1/2 transcription is repressed.
references: Sidorova JM, Breeden LL. Genes Dev 11:3032-45 (1997) <pmid:9367985>

description_ja: Cdc6はORCと物理的・機能的に相互作用し複製開始頻度を規定
description_en: Cdc6 interacts physically and functionally with ORC and sets the frequency of replication initiation.
references: Liang C, Weinreich M, Stillman B. Cell 81:667-76 (1995) <pmid:7774008>

description_ja: Cdc4/34/53経路がCdc6 N末端を介して分解
description_en: The Cdc4/34/53 pathway degrades Cdc6 through its N-terminus.
references: Drury LS, Perkins G, Diffley JF. EMBO J 16:5966-76 (1997) <pmid:9312054>

description_ja: Tah11/Sid2をCdt1オルソログとして同定、Mcm2-7ロードに関与
description_en: Tah11/Sid2 identified as the Cdt1 orthologue, involved in Mcm2-7 loading.
references: Devault A et al. Curr Biol 12:689-94 (2002) <pmid:11967159>

description_ja: Cdc7-Dbf4がMcm2と結合しリン酸化（G1/S）
description_en: Cdc7-Dbf4 binds and phosphorylates Mcm2 (G1/S).
references: Lei M et al. Genes Dev 11:3365-74 (1997) <pmid:9407029>

description_ja: Dbf4との会合によるCdc7キナーゼの細胞周期制御
description_en: Cell-cycle regulation of Cdc7 kinase through association with Dbf4.
references: Jackson AL et al. Mol Cell Biol 13:2899-908 (1993) <pmid:8474449>

description_ja: S-CDKによるSld2/Sld3リン酸化がDpb11との結合と複製開始を誘導
description_en: Phosphorylation of Sld2/Sld3 by S-CDK induces their binding to Dpb11 and replication initiation.
references: Tanaka S et al. Nature 445:328-32 (2007) <pmid:17167415>

description_ja: Rad53がSld3とDbf4をリン酸化し後期起点の発火を抑制
description_en: Rad53 phosphorylates Sld3 and Dbf4 and blocks firing of late origins.
references: Zegerman P, Diffley JF. Nature 467:474-8 (2010) <pmid:20835227>

description_ja: Mcm1-Fkh2がNdd1をG2/M遺伝子(CLB2クラスター)プロモーターに呼び込む
description_en: Mcm1-Fkh2 recruits Ndd1 to promoters of G2/M genes (CLB2 cluster).
references: Koranda M et al. Nature 406:94-8 (2000) <pmid:10894549>

description_ja: Clb-Cdc28によるNdd1 T319リン酸化がFkh2 FHAへの結合に必要（正のフィードバック）
description_en: Phosphorylation of Ndd1 T319 by Clb-Cdc28 is required for binding to the Fkh2 FHA domain (positive feedback).
references: Reynolds D et al. Genes Dev 17:1789-802 (2003) <pmid:12865300>

description_ja: Clb2はCLBの発現を促進しSBF標的(CLN1/2)を抑制、Swi4はClb2-Cdc28の基質
description_en: Clb2 promotes CLB expression and represses SBF targets (CLN1/2); Swi4 is a substrate of Clb2-Cdc28.

description_ja: Wee1ホモログSwe1がCdc28を負に制御（G2サイクリン複合体に差次的に作用）
description_en: The Wee1 homologue Swe1 negatively regulates Cdc28 (acting differentially on G2 cyclin complexes).
references: Booher RN, Deshaies RJ, Kirschner MW. EMBO J 12:3417-26 (1993) <pmid:8253069>

description_ja: Hsl1とHsl7がSwe1分解を促進（Hsl7–Swe1複合体）
description_en: Hsl1 and Hsl7 promote Swe1 degradation (Hsl7-Swe1 complex).
references: McMillan JN et al. Mol Cell Biol 19:6929-39 (1999) <pmid:10490630>

description_ja: Cla4とCdc5が順次Swe1をリン酸化・不活性化
description_en: Cla4 and Cdc5 sequentially phosphorylate and inactivate Swe1.
references: Sakchaisri K et al. PNAS 101:4124-9 (2004) <pmid:15037762>

description_ja: Clb2-Cdc28がSwe1をリン酸化しCdc5依存の過剰リン酸化・分解を促す
description_en: Clb2-Cdc28 phosphorylates Swe1, priming Cdc5-dependent hyperphosphorylation and degradation.

description_ja: Mad1/2/3がCdc20と結合、チェックポイント耐性Cdc20変異は結合を失う
description_en: Mad1/2/3 bind Cdc20; checkpoint-resistant Cdc20 mutants lose the binding.
references: Hwang LH et al. Science 279:1041-4 (1998) <pmid:9461437>

description_ja: Mad1–Mad2の強固な複合体がチェックポイント機能に必須
description_en: A tight Mad1-Mad2 complex is essential for checkpoint function.
references: Chen RH et al. Mol Biol Cell 10:2607-18 (1999) <pmid:10436016>

description_ja: Mad3はBub3, Cdc20, Mad2と相互作用
description_en: Mad3 interacts with Bub3, Cdc20 and Mad2.
references: Hardwick KG et al. J Cell Biol 148:871-82 (2000) <pmid:10704439>

description_ja: Pds1はAPC依存的に分解され後期開始を制御；Cdc20はPds1分解に必要
description_en: Pds1 is degraded in an APC-dependent manner to control anaphase onset; Cdc20 is required for Pds1 degradation.
references: Cohen-Fix O et al. Genes Dev 10:3081-93 (1996) <pmid:8985178> | Visintin R, Prinz S, Amon A. Science 278:460-3 (1997) <pmid:9334304>

description_ja: Pds1–Esp1複合体の形成。APCはPds1を分解しEsp1を解放
description_en: Formation of the Pds1-Esp1 complex. The APC degrades Pds1 and frees Esp1.
references: Ciosk R et al. Cell 93:1067-76 (1998) <pmid:9635435>

description_ja: Esp1がScc1/Mcd1を切断し姉妹染色分体を分離
description_en: Esp1 cleaves Scc1/Mcd1 and separates sister chromatids.
references: Uhlmann F, Lottspeich F, Nasmyth K. Nature 400:37-42 (1999) <pmid:10403247>

description_ja: Cdc5がScc1切断部位近傍をリン酸化し切断を促進
description_en: Cdc5 phosphorylates Scc1 near its cleavage sites and enhances cleavage.
references: Alexandru G et al. Cell 105:459-72 (2001) <pmid:11371343>

description_ja: Cdc28によるリン酸化がAPC-Cdc20活性を活性化
description_en: Phosphorylation by Cdc28 activates APC-Cdc20.
references: Rudner AD, Murray AW. J Cell Biol 149:1377-90 (2000) <pmid:10871279>

description_ja: Chk1はPds1量を維持、Rad53はCdc5を介して後期進入・M期脱出を阻止
description_en: Chk1 maintains Pds1 levels; Rad53 blocks anaphase entry and mitotic exit through Cdc5.
references: Sanchez Y et al. Science 286:1166-71 (1999) <pmid:10550056>

description_ja: 同上（Rad53–Cdc5経路）
description_en: As above (Rad53-Cdc5 branch).
references: Sanchez Y et al. Science 286:1166-71 (1999) <pmid:10550056>

description_ja: Mec1とTel1がDNA損傷時にRad53リン酸化を制御
description_en: Mec1 and Tel1 control Rad53 phosphorylation on DNA damage.
references: Sanchez Y et al. Science 271:357-60 (1996) <pmid:8553072>

description_ja: リン酸化Rad9がRad53 FHAドメインと結合
description_en: Phosphorylated Rad9 binds the FHA domains of Rad53.
references: Sun Z et al. Science 281:272-4 (1998) <pmid:9657725>

description_ja: Mrc1が複製ストレス時のRad53活性化を媒介
description_en: Mrc1 mediates Rad53 activation under replication stress.
references: Alcasabas AA et al. Nat Cell Biol 3:958-65 (2001) <pmid:11715016>

description_ja: Hct1/Cdh1はClb2分解（APC）を制御
description_en: Hct1/Cdh1 controls Clb2 degradation (APC).
references: Schwab M, Lutum AS, Seufert W. Cell 90:683-93 (1997) <pmid:9288748> | Visintin R, Prinz S, Amon A. Science 278:460-3 (1997) <pmid:9334304>

description_ja: CDKによるHct1リン酸化がAPCとの結合を阻害
description_en: Phosphorylation of Hct1 by CDK blocks its binding to the APC.
references: Zachariae W et al. Science 282:1721-4 (1998) <pmid:9831566> | Jaspersen SL et al. Curr Biol 9:227-36 (1999) <pmid:10074450>

description_ja: Cdc14がHct1を脱リン酸化・活性化
description_en: Cdc14 dephosphorylates and activates Hct1.
references: Jaspersen SL et al. Curr Biol 9:227-36 (1999) <pmid:10074450> | Visintin R et al. Mol Cell 2:709-18 (1998) <pmid:9885559>

description_ja: Cdc14がSic1とSwi5を脱リン酸化しCDK不活性化を促進
description_en: Cdc14 dephosphorylates Sic1 and Swi5, promoting CDK inactivation.
references: Visintin R et al. Mol Cell 2:709-18 (1998) <pmid:9885559>

description_ja: 後期にSwi5依存的にSIC1が転写される
description_en: SIC1 is transcribed in late mitosis in a Swi5-dependent manner.
references: Knapp D et al. Mol Cell Biol 16:5701-7 (1996) <pmid:8816483> | Toyn JH et al. Genetics 145:85-96 (1997) <pmid:9017392>

description_ja: Net1(Cfi1)がCdc14を核小体RENT複合体に隔離・阻害
description_en: Net1 (Cfi1) sequesters and inhibits Cdc14 in the nucleolar RENT complex.

description_ja: 後期にTem1依存的にCdc14がRENTから解離
description_en: Cdc14 is released from RENT in late anaphase in a Tem1-dependent manner.

description_ja: Cdc15がMob1結合Dbf2を直接リン酸化・活性化
description_en: Cdc15 directly phosphorylates and activates Mob1-bound Dbf2.
references: Mah AS, Jang J, Deshaies RJ. PNAS 98:7325-30 (2001) <pmid:11404483>

description_ja: Bub2-Bfa1はTem1の2成分GAP；Bfa1単独でもTem1を阻害
description_en: Bub2-Bfa1 is a two-component GAP for Tem1; Bfa1 alone also inhibits Tem1.
references: Ro HS, Song S, Lee KS. PNAS 99:5436-41 (2002) <pmid:11959999>

description_ja: Cdc5がBfa1をリン酸化しGAP活性を阻害
description_en: Cdc5 phosphorylates Bfa1 and inhibits its GAP activity.
references: Hu F et al. Cell 107:655-65 (2001) <pmid:11733064> | Geymonat M et al. J Biol Chem 278:14591-4 (2003) <pmid:12637549>

description_ja: FEARネットワークが後期初期のCdc14放出を促進
description_en: The FEAR network promotes Cdc14 release in early anaphase.
references: Stegmeier F, Visintin R, Amon A. Cell 108:207-20 (2002) <pmid:11832211>

description_ja: Clb-CDKによるNet1リン酸化がCdc14放出の基盤
description_en: Phosphorylation of Net1 by Clb-CDK underlies Cdc14 release.
references: Azzam R et al. Science 305:516-9 (2004) <pmid:15273393>

description_ja: Separaseが PP2A-Cdc55 を抑制しNet1リン酸化を可能にする
description_en: Separase down-regulates PP2A-Cdc55, allowing Net1 phosphorylation.
references: Queralt E et al. Cell 125:719-32 (2006) <pmid:16713564>

description_ja: Cdc5はFEAR因子Esp1, Slk19およびCdc14と物理的に会合
description_en: Cdc5 physically associates with the FEAR components Esp1 and Slk19 and with Cdc14.
references: Rahal R, Amon A. Cell Cycle 7:3262-72 (2008) <pmid:18927509>

description_ja: Yox1/Yhp1がMcm1と結合しECB依存転写(CLN3, SWI4, CDC6, MCM)をM/G1期に限定
description_en: Yox1/Yhp1 bind Mcm1 and restrict ECB-dependent transcription (CLN3, SWI4, CDC6, MCM) to M/G1.
references: Pramila T et al. Genes Dev 16:3034-45 (2002) <pmid:12464633>

description_ja: Cln3-Cdc28がWhi7をリン酸化して不活性化する。Whi7はWhi5のパラログ。
description_en: Cln3-Cdc28 phosphorylates and inactivates Whi7, a paralogue of Whi5.
references: Gomar-Alba M et al. Nat Commun 8:329 (2017) <pmid:28839131>

description_ja: Whi7がSBFに結合してG1/S転写を抑える。Whi5と並列のStart抑制因子。
description_en: Whi7 binds SBF and represses G1/S transcription; a Start repressor acting in parallel with Whi5.
references: Gomar-Alba M et al. Nat Commun 8:329 (2017) <pmid:28839131>

description_ja: Pho85によるWhi7の制御。作用の向きと部位は原著で要確認。
description_en: Regulation of Whi7 by Pho85. Direction and sites should be checked in the original paper.
references: Ros-Carrero C et al. EMBO Rep 25:745-69 (2024) <pmid:38233647>

description_ja: シャペロンYdj1/Ssa1がCln3の放出と核移行を助ける。保持・放出の分子実体は見直しが進行中。
description_en: The chaperones Ydj1/Ssa1 help release Cln3 and its nuclear accumulation. The molecular basis of retention and release is under revision.
references: Vergés E et al. Mol Cell 26:649-62 (2007) <pmid:17560371> | Moreno DF et al. Life Sci Alliance 2:e201800277 (2019) <pmid:30988162>

description_ja: Cdc48がCln3の放出に関わる。
description_en: Cdc48 takes part in the release of Cln3.
references: Parisi E et al. EMBO J 37:e98724 (2018) <pmid:29950310>

description_ja: PP2A-Cdc55がWhi5を脱リン酸化してStartを遅らせる。貧栄養ではRim15-Igo1/2がこれを抑える。
description_en: PP2A-Cdc55 dephosphorylates Whi5 and delays Start. In poor nutrients Rim15-Igo1/2 counteract this.
references: Talarek N et al. eLife 6:e26233 (2017) <pmid:28594326>

description_ja: Cln3-Cdk1がRim15を抑制し、Whi5リン酸化の恒常性を保つ。
description_en: Cln3-Cdk1 inhibits Rim15, giving homeostatic control of Whi5 phosphorylation.
references: Talarek N et al. eLife 6:e26233 (2017) <pmid:28594326>

description_ja: 浸透圧ストレスでHog1がSic1のT173をリン酸化し、ユビキチン化を妨げて安定化。G1で停止させる。
description_en: Under osmostress Hog1 phosphorylates Sic1 on T173, which interferes with its ubiquitination and stabilizes it, arresting cells in G1.
references: Escoté X et al. Nat Cell Biol 6:997-1002 (2004) <pmid:15448699> | Adrover MÀ et al. Sci Signal 4:ra63 (2011) <pmid:21954289>

description_ja: Stb1がSwi6を介してSBF/MBFに結合し、G1/S転写を調節する。
description_en: Stb1 binds SBF/MBF through Swi6 and modulates G1/S transcription.
references: de Bruin RA et al. Mol Cell Biol 28:6919-28 (2008) <pmid:18794370>

description_ja: Msa1/Msa2がSBF・MBFに結合してG1/S転写のタイミングを調節する。
description_en: Msa1/Msa2 bind SBF and MBF and tune the timing of G1/S transcription.
references: Ashe M et al. J Biol Chem 283:6040-9 (2008) <pmid:18160399> | Miles S et al. PLoS Genet 12:e1006088 (2016) <pmid:27272642>

description_ja: Cks1がCdc28に結合し、リン酸化済み部位を足場に多点リン酸化を進める。Sic1分解のスイッチ性を担う。
description_en: Cks1 binds Cdc28 and docks on already phosphorylated sites to drive multisite phosphorylation; this underlies the switch-like degradation of Sic1.
references: Kõivomägi M et al. Nature 480:128-31 (2011) <pmid:21993622>

description_ja: Clb5-Cdc28がRxLドッキングを使ってSic1をリン酸化し、自らの阻害因子の分解を完成させる。
description_en: Clb5-Cdc28 uses RxL docking to phosphorylate Sic1, completing the destruction of its own inhibitor.
references: Kõivomägi M et al. Nature 480:128-31 (2011) <pmid:21993622>

description_ja: Rif1がPP1（Glc7）を呼び込み、DDKによるMcm4のリン酸化を打ち消して起点発火を抑える。
description_en: Rif1 recruits PP1 (Glc7), reverses DDK phosphorylation of Mcm4 and restrains origin firing.
references: Hiraga S et al. Genes Dev 28:372-83 (2014) <pmid:24532715> | Mattarocci S et al. Cell Rep 7:62-9 (2014) <pmid:24685139>

description_ja: DDKの必須標的はMcm4・Mcm6。再構成系で確定した。
description_en: Mcm4 and Mcm6 are the essential targets of DDK, as established in the reconstituted system.
references: Yeeles JT et al. Nature 519:431-5 (2015) <pmid:25739503>

description_ja: Sld3-Sld7がDDKでリン酸化されたMCMを読み取って結合し、Cdc45を呼び込む。
description_en: Sld3-Sld7 read DDK-phosphorylated MCM, bind it and bring in Cdc45.
references: Deegan TD et al. EMBO J 35:961-73 (2016) <pmid:26912723>

description_ja: Mcm10がMCM複合体に直接結合し、CMGヘリカーゼの活性化に働く。
description_en: Mcm10 binds the MCM complex directly and acts in activation of the CMG helicase.
references: Douglas ME, Diffley JF. J Biol Chem 291:5879-88 (2016) <pmid:26719337>

description_ja: Rad53がDDKのMCMへの結合を妨げる。
description_en: Rad53 prevents DDK from binding MCM.
references: Abd Wahab S, Remus D. eLife 9:e58571 (2020) <pmid:32701054>

description_ja: MBF標的であるNrm1がMBFに結合して転写を止める負のフィードバック。
description_en: Nrm1, itself an MBF target, binds MBF and shuts off transcription (negative feedback).
references: de Bruin RA et al. Mol Cell 23:483-96 (2006) <pmid:16916637>

description_ja: 複製ストレス時にRad53がNrm1をリン酸化してMBFから外し、G1/S転写を維持する。
description_en: Under replication stress Rad53 phosphorylates Nrm1, releasing it from MBF and keeping G1/S transcription on.
references: Travesa A et al. EMBO J 31:1811-22 (2012) <pmid:22333915>

description_ja: Acm1が14-3-3（Bmh1/2）と複合体を作り、KEN box・D boxを使う擬似基質としてCdh1を阻害する。G1後期からM期後半まで存在。
description_en: Acm1 forms a complex with 14-3-3 (Bmh1/2) and inhibits Cdh1 as a pseudosubstrate using its KEN box and D box. Present from late G1 to late M.
references: Martinez JS et al. Mol Cell Biol 26:9162-76 (2006) <pmid:17030612> | Enquist-Newman M et al. Mol Cell 30:437-46 (2008) <pmid:18498748> | Burton JL et al. EMBO J 30:1818-29 (2011) <pmid:21460798>

description_ja: Cdc28によるリン酸化がBmh結合とAcm1の安定化に必要。
description_en: Phosphorylation by Cdc28 is required for Bmh binding and stabilization of Acm1.
references: Ostapenko D et al. Mol Cell Biol 28:4971-83 (2008) <pmid:18519589>

description_ja: Clb3特異的なPxxPxFドッキングモチーフをもつ基質Csa1（Ypr174c）。
description_en: Csa1 (Ypr174c), a substrate carrying the Clb3-specific PxxPxF docking motif.
references: Örd M et al. Cell Rep 31:107757 (2020) <pmid:32553169>

description_ja: Mih1（Cdc25）がSwe1によるCdc28-Y19の抑制性リン酸化を外す。
description_en: Mih1 (Cdc25) removes the inhibitory Y19 phosphorylation placed on Cdc28 by Swe1.
references: Pal G et al. J Cell Biol 180:931-45 (2008) <pmid:18316413>

description_ja: PP2A-Cdc55がCdk1によるSwe1のリン酸化に拮抗し、Swe1の活性化を制御する。
description_en: PP2A-Cdc55 opposes Cdk1 phosphorylation of Swe1 and controls Swe1 activation.
references: Harvey SL et al. Mol Biol Cell 22:3595-608 (2011) <pmid:21849476>

description_ja: Zds1/Zds2がPP2A-Cdc55に結合してその局在と働きを調節し、分裂期進入を助ける。
description_en: Zds1/Zds2 bind PP2A-Cdc55, regulate its localization and function, and help mitotic entry.
references: Queralt E, Uhlmann F. J Cell Biol 182:873-83 (2008) <pmid:18762578> | Calabria I et al. J Cell Sci 125:2875-84 (2012) <pmid:22427694>

description_ja: Rim15（Greatwall）がIgo1/2（エンドスルフィン）をリン酸化する。
description_en: Rim15 (Greatwall) phosphorylates Igo1/2 (endosulfines).
references: Juanes MA et al. PLoS Genet 9:e1003575 (2013) <pmid:23861665>

description_ja: リン酸化Igo1/2がPP2A-Cdc55を阻害する。
description_en: Phosphorylated Igo1/2 inhibit PP2A-Cdc55.
references: Juanes MA et al. PLoS Genet 9:e1003575 (2013) <pmid:23861665>

description_ja: Hog1がHsl1のHsl7結合部位をリン酸化し、Hsl7がセプチン環から外れてSwe1が蓄積。G2で停止させる。
description_en: Hog1 phosphorylates the Hsl7-docking site of Hsl1; Hsl7 leaves the septin ring, Swe1 accumulates and cells arrest in G2.
references: Clotet J et al. EMBO J 25:2338-46 (2006) <pmid:16676003>

description_ja: 未接着キネトコアでMps1がSpc105（KNL1）のMELTモチーフをリン酸化する。
description_en: At unattached kinetochores Mps1 phosphorylates the MELT motifs of Spc105 (KNL1).
references: London N et al. Curr Biol 22:900-6 (2012) <pmid:22521787>

description_ja: Bub3がリン酸化MELTを直接読み取り、Bub3-Bub1がキネトコアに載る。
description_en: Bub3 reads phosphorylated MELT directly, bringing Bub3-Bub1 to the kinetochore.
references: Primorac I et al. eLife 2:e01030 (2013) <pmid:24066227>

description_ja: キネトコア上のBub1もMps1でリン酸化され、Mad1-Mad2が結合できるようになる。
description_en: Kinetochore-bound Bub1 is also phosphorylated by Mps1, which lets Mad1-Mad2 bind.
references: London N, Biggins S. Genes Dev 28:140-52 (2014) <pmid:24402315> | Moyle MW et al. J Cell Biol 204:647-57 (2014) <pmid:24567362> | Aravamudhan P et al. Mol Biol Cell 27:3405-17 (2016) <pmid:27170178>

description_ja: リン酸化Bub1がMad1-Mad2を呼び込む。
description_en: Phosphorylated Bub1 recruits Mad1-Mad2.
references: London N, Biggins S. Genes Dev 28:140-52 (2014) <pmid:24402315> | Moyle MW et al. J Cell Biol 204:647-57 (2014) <pmid:24567362> | Aravamudhan P et al. Mol Biol Cell 27:3405-17 (2016) <pmid:27170178>

description_ja: Ipl1/Aurora Bが張力のない接着を不安定化し、SACを点灯させる。キネトコア経由の間接効果。
description_en: Ipl1/Aurora B destabilizes tensionless attachments and switches on the SAC; an indirect effect through the kinetochore.
references: Biggins S, Murray AW. Genes Dev 15:3118-29 (2001) <pmid:11731476>

description_ja: Bub1がH2A-S121をリン酸化してSgo1-PP2A(Rts1)をペリセントロメアに呼ぶ。張力が生じると外れる。
description_en: Bub1 phosphorylates H2A-S121 and brings Sgo1-PP2A(Rts1) to the pericentromere; it leaves once tension is established.
references: Nerusheva OO et al. Genes Dev 28:1291-309 (2014) <pmid:24939933> | Jin F, Bokros M, Wang Y. Genetics 205:1169-78 (2017) <pmid:28040741>

description_ja: PP1（Glc7）がMELTのリン酸化を外し、SACを解除する。
description_en: PP1 (Glc7) removes MELT phosphorylation and silences the SAC.
references: London N et al. Curr Biol 22:900-6 (2012) <pmid:22521787>

description_ja: APC/C-Cdc20が後期にAcm1を分解し、Cdh1の活性化を順序づける。
description_en: APC/C-Cdc20 degrades Acm1 in anaphase, ordering the activation of Cdh1.
references: Enquist-Newman M et al. Mol Cell 30:437-46 (2008) <pmid:18498748>

description_ja: 紡錘体位置がずれるとKin4がBfa1をリン酸化し、Cdc5による抑制性リン酸化を受けないようにする。
description_en: When the spindle is mispositioned Kin4 phosphorylates Bfa1, shielding it from inhibitory phosphorylation by Cdc5.
references: Maekawa H et al. J Cell Biol 179:423-36 (2007) <pmid:17967947> | Caydasi AK, Pereira G. Dev Cell 16:146-56 (2009) <pmid:19154725> | Kocakaplan D et al. eLife 10:e72833 (2021) <pmid:34633288>

description_ja: 芽側でLte1がKin4を娘側SPBから遠ざけ、Tem1を活性化させる。
description_en: In the bud Lte1 keeps Kin4 off the daughter-bound SPB, allowing Tem1 activation.
references: Bertazzi DT et al. J Cell Biol 193:1033-48 (2011) <pmid:21670215> | Falk JE, Chan LY, Amon A. PNAS 108:12584-90 (2011) <pmid:21709215> | Campbell IW, Zhou X, Amon A. Mol Biol Cell 31:906-16 (2020) <pmid:32074005>

description_ja: Glc7-Bud14がBfa1を脱リン酸化してSPOCのエフェクターを完全に活性化する。
description_en: Glc7-Bud14 dephosphorylates Bfa1 to fully activate the SPOC effector.
references: Kocakaplan D et al. eLife 10:e72833 (2021) <pmid:34633288>

description_ja: Cdc15がSPBスキャフォールドNud1をリン酸化し、Dbf2-Mob1のドッキング部位を作る。
description_en: Cdc15 phosphorylates the SPB scaffold Nud1, creating a docking site for Dbf2-Mob1.
references: Rock JM et al. Science 340:871-5 (2013) <pmid:23579499> | Campbell IW, Zhou X, Amon A. Mol Biol Cell 31:906-16 (2020) <pmid:32074005>

description_ja: リン酸化Nud1がDbf2-Mob1をSPBに呼び、Cdc15による活性化を可能にする。
description_en: Phosphorylated Nud1 recruits Dbf2-Mob1 to the SPB, where Cdc15 activates it.
references: Rock JM et al. Science 340:871-5 (2013) <pmid:23579499> | Campbell IW, Zhou X, Amon A. Mol Biol Cell 31:906-16 (2020) <pmid:32074005>

description_ja: Dbf2-Mob1がCdc14のNLS近傍をリン酸化してNLSを無効化し、細胞質に留める。
description_en: Dbf2-Mob1 phosphorylates residues next to the Cdc14 NLS, inactivating it and keeping Cdc14 in the cytoplasm.
references: Mohl DA et al. J Cell Biol 184:527-40 (2009) <pmid:19221193>

description_ja: Cdc5のプライミング後、核小体に入ったDbf2-Mob1がNet1をリン酸化してCdc14を放出させる。
description_en: After priming by Cdc5, nucleolar Dbf2-Mob1 phosphorylates Net1 and releases Cdc14.
references: Zhou X et al. eLife 10:e63645 (2021) <pmid:33481703>

description_ja: 娘細胞特異的に発現するAmn1がTem1に結合してCdc15との結合を妨げ、SPBから外して分解にも導く。
description_en: Daughter-specific Amn1 binds Tem1, blocks its binding to Cdc15, evicts it from the SPB and promotes its degradation.
references: Wang Y et al. Cell 112:697-709 (2003) <pmid:12628189> | Devault A, Piatti S. J Cell Sci 134:jcs258972 (2021) <pmid:34518877>
